name: teachai
description: Lesson planning with bounded curriculum retrieval and streaming output

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @teachai/rag build && concurrently -n rag,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @teachai/rag dev" "pnpm --filter @teachai/api dev" "pnpm --filter @teachai/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @teachai/rag build && pnpm --filter @teachai/api build && pnpm --filter @teachai/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @teachai/rag build && pnpm --filter @teachai/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @teachai/web typecheck
